m2-coverage-script.title: scripts/fingerprint_class_coverage_675.py: synthetic-recovery coverage on the real bounded slice
m2-coverage-script.imperative: Create scripts/fingerprint_class_coverage_675.py (test-after/inspection run, per handoff test mode -- it is a research diagnostic, not promoted logic). Reproduce the #665 method (scripts/pooling_imbalance_validation_665.py, read-only) EXACTLY as pinned in the handoff: read --slice-db (default .agent-work/666-driver-fingerprint/artifacts/fp_slice_2023Q.db), table driver_class_observables, keep only class LIKE 'severity:%' rows (k=4), entities drivers={LEC,PER,SAI,VER} x classes (the 4 severity ids); build per-(driver,class) cell support counts by summing n_points over the 4 circuits (a cell below FINGERPRINT_UNRESOLVED_SUPPORT_FLOOR is unresolved/excluded); for N_REPS>=200 reps draw true driver/class effects + per-cell synthetic observations at those real support counts (driver_sigma=0.15, class_sigma=0.30, obs_sigma=1.0 for the TIME channel per #665; derive and state the ENERGY channel's own sigmas scaled from deployment_share's real spread), fit_two_way(values, teams=drivers, circuits=classes) (UNMODIFIED import from src.physics.layer2.pooling), wrap each shrunk axis effect in predictive_t(eff, sem, n_eff, nu_loss=4.0, rule=FormulaRule()) with sem = naive within-group SEM and n_eff = the SUMMED real observation count backing that axis (never the pooled .n), compute lo,hi = pt.interval(0.80) and hit=int(lo<=true_val<=hi), accumulate per axis per channel; emit empirical coverage + binomial 95% CI per (channel,axis), class_vs_driver gap, a generalizes flag per channel (true iff class-axis CI upper bound < FINGERPRINT_UNDER_COVERAGE_BOUND=0.60), and a shared_floor_recommendation per channel with a stated derivation. Also compute the SECONDARY descriptive LOO empirical coverage on real time_deficit_s values, clearly flagged as a different quantity. Write the verdict JSON to .agent-work/666-driver-fingerprint/artifacts/coverage_675_verdict.json (gitignored). Run the script and confirm it succeeds and the JSON has the required shape (command-check c1).

postconditions.statement: script runs offline against the real slice DB and emits coverage_675_verdict.json with per-channel/per-axis coverage+CI, class_vs_driver, generalizes flags, shared_floor_recommendation, interpretation

why_trail.why: Handoff complete. Coverage method is: real per-(driver,class) cell support counts from fp_slice_2023Q.db (n_points summed across 4 circuits), synthetic ground truth injected per #665's generative model, fit_two_way (unmodified) + naive group SEM wrapped in predictive_t with n_eff=summed real obs count (never pooled .n), 0.80 interval coverage measured over >=200 reps with binomial CI, for both time (time_deficit_s) and energy (deployment_share) channels, both driver and class axes. Proceeding to build frozen_constants.py test-first.
frozen_constants.py + package init written per handoff (module-level immutable mapping, all 4 pre-registered values verbatim, no extras). Test now green.

coverage script built + run successfully against the real bounded slice (64 rows, LEC/PER/SAI/VER x 4 severity classes). Verdict emitted with per-channel/axis coverage+CI, class_vs_driver gap, generalizes flags (both channels True, class CI-upper 0.314/0.369 << 0.60), shared_floor_recommendation, interpretation. IMPORTANT finding for commander: driver axis ALSO under-covers nearly as badly as class axis here (time: driver=0.349 vs class=0.281, gap=-0.0675; energy: driver=0.309 vs class=0.335, gap=+0.026) -- analytically confirmed this is because the bounded slice restricts BOTH axes to only k=4 levels (4 drivers, 4 classes), so the naive-SEM-based predictive_t interval misses the estimated-grand-mean reference-noise term (~sigma/sqrt(#groups)) on EITHER axis with few groups -- unlike #665's original setup where the driver axis had ~20 real F1 drivers (much better calibrated) and only the class axis had k=4. Will flag prominently in IMPLEMENTER_RESULT as an out-of-scope/adjudication-needed observation; did not alter the pre-registered method or thresholds to compensate.
IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written+delivered; verification commands reproduced; git status confirms nothing staged. All 4 plan items complete -- ready to release the lease as the final step.
